# Statis — Agent Execution Infrastructure

> The execution layer for production AI agents.

Statis is the layer between AI agents and production systems. Agents propose actions, policies evaluate them, a distributed lock guarantees exactly-once execution, and a SHA-256 receipt is written atomically.

## Primitives

- Action Contract: POST /actions — agent declares intent, nothing executes yet
- Policy Engine: POST /actions/{id}/evaluate — deterministic rule evaluation
- Execution Lock: distributed lock on action ID, adapter fires once
- Ledger Receipt: SHA-256 tamper-evident hash, immutable proof

## SDKs

- Python: pip install statis-ai (PyPI)
- TypeScript: npm install statis-ai (npm)

## Adapters

Stripe, Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Airflow, PostgreSQL
